source_evidence.excerpt:
def get_timesteps(self, num_inference_steps, strength, device):
        # get the original timestep using init_timestep
        init_timestep = min(num_inference_steps * strength, num_inference_steps)

        t_start = int(max(num_inference_steps - init_timestep, 0))
        timesteps = self.scheduler.timesteps[t_start * self.scheduler.order :]
        if hasattr(self.scheduler, "set_begin_index"):
            self.scheduler.set_begin_index(t_start * self.scheduler.order)

        return timesteps, num_inference_steps - t_start

limitations: Technical pass does not establish realism, unchanged support geometry, correct shadows/reflections, or training acceptance.
Protection refers to new paired-render with_part RGB. Historic source RGB and prior 100-set assets are separate; colors are not byte-identical.
Compositions use display-linear sRGB EOTF of AgX PNG; scene-linear EXRs are not used.
Clipping and quantization lose information; both full-frame and outside-protection clipping are reported.
Manifest matching checks current bytes and source semantics; it is not an independently instrumented GPU execution trace.
CUDA allocator peaks and sampling time exclude model loading and broader system costs.
